approval.confirmation_reference: The user said to continue and previously authorized automatic evidence-optimal execution within the frozen paper plan.
approval.scope: One immutable C07-only zero-training local-slot factor attribution; no C08, graph, retraining or threshold change.

corrective_scope: V1 failed only because a paper-figure histogram treated anchor norm >=80 m as invalid. V1R preserves every numeric target and all scientific gates, records the true maximum, and counts values beyond the 80 m display range in an explicit overflow bin.

estimated_cost.compute: Three deterministic frozen-checkpoint C07 inference passes plus exact tie-safe ranking of 18 pre-registered factor scores.

failure_policy: Any source metric reproduction, count, hash, environment, symmetry, resource or isolation failure stops and seals system FAIL. Diagnostic factor scores cannot be promoted to a new method, threshold or graph result inside this run.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.classification: If hard slot identity is safely nonempty in at least 2/3 seeds, diagnose multiplicative confidence collapse; else if soft affinity is safely nonempty in at least 2/3, diagnose hard-argmax fragmentation; otherwise diagnose slot identity and confidence as not cross-seed safe.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.factors: Report 18 frozen factor scores: hard slot identity, each endpoint confidence component/product, soft slot affinity/presence/safe scores, and the exact deployed score; all use tie-safe thresholds.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.isolation: Exactly 193932 C07 inference rows, zero optimizer steps, zero C08/C09/C10, graph and M-TARE reads.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.reproduction: The deployed structured score must exactly reproduce source best/safe threshold, TP, FP, FN and selected-pair counts for all three seeds.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.resources: Host RSS <=4 GiB, result <=1 GiB and wall time <=4 h; GPU process memory remains below16 GiB.

purpose: Use the three frozen local-slot checkpoints to decompose the failed C07 structured score into slot identity, dustbin/second-slot margin, slot presence, primitive existence, endpoint evidence and entropy factors without training or changing the deployment gate.
retention: Keep per-seed and per-task factor metrics, endpoint zero-rate/assignment statistics, comparison PNG/PDF/SVG, environment, commands, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal; retain no raw pair arrays.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: 10 disjoint C07 topology parents and 30 paired geometry tasks; the three geometry variants are repeated measures within each parent.
sampling.rule: Read every one of the 64644 C07 five-frame sequences exactly once per frozen seed. All 442936 observable positive attachment pairs remain in the recall denominator; no row, pair, task or seed is selected or removed.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated Cano assets; redistribution remains subject to upstream licensing.
raw_sources: sealed P1a corrected C01--C07 sensor pose and construction-program primitive endpoints
sealed P1b C01--C07 five-frame cropped primitive axes and endpoint-neighbor labels
sealed V2 relation failure attribution establishing zero safe true attachment for all three seeds

split.fit: C01-C06 are not read; training is finished and all checkpoints are immutable.
split.historical_pollution_audit: The factor list and diagnostic decision tree are frozen before execution; no result-dependent factor is added.
split.selection: C07 is used only to attribute the already declared source failure. It cannot authorize a factor formula as a replacement deployment method.
split.strict_test: C08/C09/C10 and all M-TARE benchmark worlds remain unread.

teacher.labels: Per-observed-endpoint local composition clique/dustbin and disconnected-overlap hard-negative relation.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or planner is executed in this attribution.
teacher.source: Sealed P1b construction attachment cliques plus sealed endpoint observability mask.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Teacher/world/node/TNG/identity/absolute pose/future frames never enter model forward. No C08+ or planner state is read.
teacher.valid_mask: Only dual-observed cross-primitive upper-triangle endpoint pairs are candidates; all observable positives remain in the recall denominator even when primitive existence rejects them.

teacher_source: The same sealed P1b construction attachments and dual-endpoint observability mask used by the failed source gate; labels are read only for C07 scoring and per-factor attribution.
